heading: Paint labour rates in Karachi and painter charges
text: Use our painting cost calculator to plan wall painting costs in Karachi. Enter room dimensions and select paint quality, coats and preparation to compare labour and material costs. The 2026 calculator uses Sikander Arts configured estimates; final painter charges are confirmed after reviewing your property and scope.

heading: How to measure a room for a painting price estimate
text: Measure length, width and height in feet. Wall area is 2 × (length + width) × height. Ceiling area is length × width when selected. A 12 × 10 × 10 ft room has 440 sq ft of walls and 120 sq ft of ceiling. Floor area is different from paintable area. Door/window deductions apply only when woodwork is selected: 21 sq ft per door and 12 sq ft per window.

heading: Paint coverage, litres and wastage
text: Finish-paint litres equal paintable area × actual coats ÷ coverage per litre per coat. Add the chosen wastage allowance, then round up to whole packs. The example coverage of 100 sq ft/litre/coat, 10% wastage and 4-litre pack must be replaced with your selected product specifications. Primer, putty, texture and wood coatings need separate product quantities.

heading: Does the estimate include paint materials?
text: With paint selected, choose the existing area-based material estimate or whole-pack pricing. Whole-pack pricing replaces the area material charge; it does not add a second material bill. Without paint removes finish-paint material and wastage only; selected preparation and other extras remain.

heading: Roof, scaffolding and minimum-job charges
text: Selected roof work adds 5% of the painting subtotal, including selected preparation and paint wastage. Scaffolding is a separate allowance. The minimum-job adjustment only tops up a smaller calculated total to the entered minimum; it is not an extra fee on every job. Confirm these amounts with the team before booking.

heading: Latest rates and planning a 2027 painting budget
text: Prices can change with products, surface repairs and access. Use this price estimate to plan, then request the latest project quotation from Sikander Arts. A 2027 budget based on current estimates is provisional until the rates and project scope are reviewed; these are not confirmed future market prices.

heading: Can I estimate waterproofing or epoxy flooring here?
text: The numeric estimate uses room wall and ceiling measurements. Service and property selections describe the enquiry but do not introduce separate specialist pricing. Waterproofing, epoxy floors and specialist finishes require a project-specific quotation.
